hero.title: Who is behind Klacks
hero.subtitle: Klacks is developed by Heribert Gasparoli in Liebefeld (Switzerland) and is open source under the GNU AGPL-3.0.
founder.title: The founder
founder.story.0: As a developer, Heribert Gasparoli wrote a personnel scheduling program for 3500 to 4000 employees for a large security company in Switzerland years ago.
founder.story.1: Later, his wife needed extensive care at home. He noticed that the home care service did very good nursing work but was hopelessly overwhelmed by the scheduling.
founder.story.2: That is how he decided to make his knowledge available to everyone, so that a task as important as workforce scheduling can be solved properly. Today he puts his whole heart into Klacks.
founder.text: He is responsible for everything that is said and done under the name Klacks. He works without pay. Income from setup, support and commercial licenses is meant to cover costs, not to make a profit.
ai.title: A company that works with AI
ai.text: AI assistants help with research, texts and translations, and with drafts for marketing. What an AI writes is labeled as such.
ai.ownerItems.1: Every publication in the name of Klacks
ai.ownerItems.2: Complaints, data loss and security incidents
ai.ownerItems.3: Questions about labor law, pay and supplements in a specific case
ai.note: No AI makes commitments in the name of Klacks. The founder personally handles inquiries; for languages other than German, French and English, an AI helps him with translation.
continuity.title: Klacks is built to last
continuity.subtitle: You have to be able to rely on scheduling software for years. That is why we are building a community that carries on the further development of Klacks, as with Redmine.
continuity.items.0.title: A community in the making
continuity.items.0.text: Following the example of open source projects such as Redmine, we are building a community that carries the further development of Klacks. It is still at the beginning.
continuity.items.1.title: Bugs fixed quickly
continuity.items.1.text: We fix bugs quickly with the help of AI tools. Every new version goes through automated tests before it is released.
continuity.items.2.title: The code is open
continuity.items.2.text: The complete source code is on GitHub under the AGPL-3.0. Anyone may continue to develop and support Klacks.
continuity.items.3.title: Your data stays with you
continuity.items.3.text: The installation and the database run in your business. The data is stored in PostgreSQL, an open database; with standard tools you can reach all your data at any time, even without Klacks.
continuity.items.4.title: Klacks keeps running
continuity.items.4.text: If no new version is released, your installation keeps working with the last version installed.
